notes: Studio architecture upgrade, step 4: a constrained layout solver.

Positions are computed from constraints instead of tried at random. Same input always gives the same result, and a layout that is already valid is left untouched - only real violations (off-canvas, text on the product, overlapping elements) are resolved.
Elements sharing a component id move together, so a text block and its decoration lines never drift apart. Unresolvable conflicts are reported rather than forced.
